summary.text: Peggy Rotundo is a Democratic member of the Maine Senate for Senate District 21, which covers Lewiston in Androscoggin County.
The Senate page lists Peggy Rotundo as chair of the Appropriations and Financial Affairs committee.

paragraphs.text: The page lists Senate service in the 120th through 123rd, 131st and 132nd Legislatures and prior service in the House in the 124th through 127th Legislatures.
Committee assignments listed: Appropriations and Financial Affairs (chair); Senatorial Vote.
